note: Kentucky State Parks campground strung along Claylick Creek in a wooded hollow, well inland from Greenbo Lake (the lake frontage is at the lodge). The long full-hookup pull-throughs are sites 44-51 and 60-69. Lodge, pool, marina and mini golf in the park. --Claude
summary: Kept. Reopened after water/electric renovations. Fees now 35-60 (W/E $35/$40, full hookup $45-$55, holiday up to $60); policy-row reservation fee and extra-person cleared. 74 hookup sites (39 full, 35 W/E), 50A, 17 pull-throughs; showers, restrooms, 2 dumps, grocery, no WiFi; year-round confirmed. Pin fine; website fix.
